Legal

Privacy Policy

This page explains what information Mannschaft Sprachzentrum collects when you use this website and how it is used.

Information we collect

When you submit our contact form, we collect the name, email address, phone number, and message you provide, solely to respond to your enquiry.

How we use your information

We use your contact details only to communicate with you about course information, enrollment, and related administrative matters. We do not sell or share your data with third parties for marketing purposes.

Data retention

Enquiry data is retained only as long as necessary to respond to your request and maintain accurate business records, after which it is deleted.

Your rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us at info@mannschaft-sprachzentrum.com.
